title: Zürich
extract:
Zürich (German: [ˈtsyːrɪç] ; see below) is the largest city in Switzerland and the capital of the canton of Zürich (one of the 26 cantons). It is in north-central Switzerland, at the northwestern tip of Lake Zürich.
The second paragraph is not part of the description.
extract_html: Zürich is the largest city in Switzerland.
